answer: One defense is escrowed identity bonds with randomized audits. Each agent locks a refundable bond into a public lagoon of staked collateral before it may transact. Every epoch the protocol audits a random subset: each must show a verifiable trace of useful computation before a deadline. Failed or correlated identities get their bonds slashed, so a sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately and risks losing them all at once. Like crossing a canyon, each identity pays its own toll, and anyone spinning a fable about being many people faces one correlated ruin.
